methodologyNote: Percent of Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025 respondents who reported using the item (multi-select). Not sales market share.
attributionNote: Derived from Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025 (ODbL 1.0 / DbCL 1.0). Share-alike applies to the derived database.
aiSummary: In 2025, Visual Studio Code led ides and editors in Worldwide at 40.4% (share of surveyed developers). Visual Studio ranked second at 15.42%, followed by Notepad++ at 14.59%.

faqs.question: Which item leads ides and editors in Worldwide?
faqs.answer: Visual Studio Code leads at 40.4% in 2025 (share of surveyed developers). Source: https://survey.stackoverflow.co/2025/.

faqs.question: What does the share of surveyed developers metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are share of surveyed developers from the cited source for 2025. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for ides and editors in Worldwide?
faqs.answer: Visual Studio Code (40.4%), Visual Studio (15.42%), Notepad++ (14.59%) in 2025.
